Container.Name: Household-Hub
Container.Overview: Shared household finances and calendar. Bills with due dates and reminders, accounts, transactions, monthly budgets, and a family calendar for appointments and due dates. Every person in the house gets their own login, private items stay private, and reminders go out by in-app alerts, Windows notifications, phone push (ntfy), email, text message or Discord/webhook. A Windows app is available.
Container.Changes: 1.3.0: daily automatic backups, subscription finder with price alerts, cash-flow forecast with low-balance alerts, income schedules, Mark paid button on phone alerts. 1.2.0: several folders/labels per mailbox, statement folders that import by themselves. 1.1.0: statement import (CSV/OFX/QFX, PayPal), email reader for bank, PayPal and bill emails, transfers, bill matching. 1.0.0: first release.

Config.Name: Statements folder
Config.Description: Put bank and PayPal statement files (CSV, OFX, QFX) in subfolders here; Household Hub imports them by itself (read only, nothing is moved). Set up in Settings, Auto import.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Reminders go out on this clock
